mapper.update: UPDATE community_board SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, category=#{category}, file_name=#{uuidFileName}, file_size=#{fileSize}, origin_file_name=#{originFileName} WHERE post_id=#{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, title, category, c.file_name AS uuidFileName, content, read_view, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.origin_file_name AS originFileName, c.user_id AS userId, u.username -- users 테이블에서 username을 가져옵니다 FROM community_board c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id -- users 테이블과 JOIN WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT post_id as postId, title,category,file_name as uuidFileName, content,read_view, created_at as createdAt, origin_file_name as originFileName,user_id as userId FROM community_board
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{startPost}, #{postsPerPage}
